findings.summary: The sentence pairs the four shares 0.21, 0.20, 0.18, 0.17 with cells 2412, 2411, 2410, 2413, but witness-graded-16-80.json records those shares for 2412, 5343, 5344 and 2411, so the inner lobe reads as carrying 0.76 of the numerator when it carries 0.46.

The prose says each receipt names the operator's own digest, but the three bound receipts and the control receipt all read geometry_digest "synthetic", so the headline readings carry no recorded proof that the operator matched the rebuilt mesh.

test_logs cites check-1337279.log, which ends in KeyError 'path' with no EXIT line, while the passing check row the fragment cites was printed by witness-1338104.log, which the manifest does not name.
localise() re-implements the top-cell and top-cell-pair split of a witness that scripts/iron_operator_bound/localise.py:141 already owns.
generalised_spectrum() builds the dense generalised block eigenproblem independently of the owner nova/biot/magnetisation.py:370 galerkin_block_spectrum.
--mode check is described as the instrument's own gate but no calibration identity raises on mismatch, so a regression would print a larger error and still exit zero.
skew_norm's relative residual divides by an eigenvalue at the round-off floor, so the residual 0.76 it reports measures nothing; the fragment cites the skew norm without it.
The top-direction readings exist only in an uncited scratch log from an uncommitted script, not in any receipt the fragment names.
The commits list stops at f2afbe069 and omits ea42512d2, which changes the instrument, and bb6c6c8b9, which writes the evidence fragment at the reviewed head.
